**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation on Sanofi. Exclusivity runs in our favour — the Article III licences are exclusive to Sanofi even as to RevMed (p0248, p0250), and Sections 3.6/10.x treat exclusivity as a licensee benefit. Manufacturing and Supply (7.1–7.3) contains no obligation to source Product solely from RevMed, and RevMed must in fact help us stand up our own third-party supply arrangements (7.2).

Noted in the rationale but not flagged:
- RevMed's one-time exclusive Co-Promotion Option over a share of U.S. Detailing (8.7(a)) — a negotiated co-promotion right, conditioned on RevMed proving resources to our reasonable satisfaction and waived if not timely exercised, not exclusive dealing.
- Section 12.2(d) termination right if we pursue a Competing Product — a termination consequence with an election to avoid it, not a covenant restricting our freedom to buy or develop elsewhere.

This sits at the preferred position, so no redline was warranted.
